notes_for_editor: Thin record. The tower facts come from one page (Central US Lookouts) that reproduces a 1941 Coast and Geodetic Survey description. The Encyclopedia of Arkansas entry gives agency context only and does not mention Shinn. No build date, removal date, staffing, fire, site description or access information was found in the two web searches and the pages read. The NGS datasheet for EJ1868 is withheld as non-public, so the survey could not be checked directly. Brief coordinates 34.374, -92.9759 agree with the NGS listing's approximate position (34 22 25 N, 092 58 33 W). Height 24.4 m (80 feet) is new; the brief had none. The 'Removed' status matches the brief's gone. No photos found.
